title: Making a small irritation worse
literal_meaning: Scratch an itch into a wound.
explanation: An action that brings brief relief can deepen the original trouble. In conversation, the expression can describe reopening a minor grievance until it becomes a serious quarrel. The rebuke is directed at aggravating the problem rather than resolving it.
meaning_odia: ଛୋଟ ଅସୁବିଧାକୁ ଅଯଥା ଖୋଚି ବଡ଼ ସମସ୍ୟା କରିବା।
usage_example: A small misunderstanding has been settled, but repeated sarcastic reminders start the argument again. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The bodily image supplies a social metaphor. This entry explains that metaphor and offers no medical advice.
